info.text:
Car insurance jumped 58% in four years, then fell.

Car insurance prices rose 58% from 2021 to 2025 (BLS CPI annual averages).
In 2022, US auto insurers paid about $1.12 in claims and costs per $1 of premium (AM Best).
The average collision repair hit $4,818 in 2025, and sensor recalibration averaged about $486 in 2025 (CCC).
In the 12 months to August 2026, car insurance prices fell 5.1% while repair prices rose 5.2% (BLS).

Sources: BLS CPI, Triple-I, AM Best, CCC Crash Course 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
